# Reception Perception: The Show — 2024-01-25

**Raw transcript:** `raw/ingested/reception-perception/2024-01-25-rp-head-coaching-news-conference-championship-breakdowns.md` (immutable — do not edit)

## Summary

Fourth [[Matt Harmon]] episode ingested, with co-host **James Koh** (not
tracked). Two distinct halves.

**Half one — head-coaching carousel roundup.** Covers Atlanta's still-open
search (13+ interviews, Bill Belichick's candidacy questioned on
staff-nepotism grounds), the Chargers' expected-but-not-yet-official Jim
Harbaugh hire, Tennessee promoting Brian Callahan (Bengals OC) over Mike
Vrabel, Las Vegas retaining Antonio Pierce as HC and hiring Tom Telesco as GM,
and New England promoting Gerard Mayo as Bill Belichick's successor. Per the
low-durability guidance for coaching-carousel content, none of this was
ingested as player-relevant wiki content — no specific skill-position player's
role was discussed in connection with any of these hires. The one exception:
unconfirmed league-circle chatter that a Ben Johnson-to-Washington move is
close to being finalized, which bears directly on [[Jared Goff]]'s
already-tracked open question about Detroit's offense post-Johnson — logged
on Goff's page explicitly flagged as rumor, not fact.

**Half two — Conference Championship breakdown.** A five-way rank of the
receivers remaining in the playoffs ([[Brandon Aiyuk]], [[Amon-Ra St. Brown]], [[Deebo Samuel]], [[Zay Flowers]], [[Rashee Rice]]) — the fullest
head-to-head receiver-ranking exercise in this wiki to date — plus matchup
notes for both games (Chiefs-Ravens, Lions-49ers) covering [[Isiah Pacheco]]
(bell-cow question, Joe Thuney injury risk), [[Zay Flowers]] (tough outside
matchup vs. Kansas City), [[Jared Goff]] (Shanahan/blitz history), and
[[Brock Purdy]]/[[Brandon Aiyuk]] (continuation of the prior episode's
grip/accuracy critique). [[Christian McCaffrey]] gets a specific matchup
note plus a sentimental Super Bowl pick from both hosts.

**Not given pages/updates:** no new players introduced this episode — every
page touched already existed. Coaching hires (Callahan, Pierce/Telesco,
Mayo, the Atlanta/Chargers searches) were discussed at length but not tied to
any specific player's fantasy outlook, so none were ingested as player or
concept content.
